versions.changelog:
- Added a link to more Dreamface AI tools in the Quick Start section.

dream-talking-image 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Generate talking videos from static images and audio using the Talking Image API.
- Supports non-human faces, including pets and animated characters.
- Provides API usage instructions and upload workflow.
- Supports multiple languages and audio up to 2 minutes (m4a recommended).
